criteria.text: tj-vz7o.3 is closed only after the same 53 stored packets across 19 scenarios have two independent blind raw-rubric reads each, every score file has exactly 15 criteria and no n_a field, reader disagreement is printed, and the change from the previous 13.58/30 raw mean is reported with a between-scenario interval.

tj-vz7o.6 is closed only after substantive-response coverage and time-to-first-reply are computed for both the 1400-dialogue client corpus and the 53 stored bot packets, every figure carries its denominator, and the corpus result reconciles with the client continuity counts.

tj-vz7o.7 is closed only after 15-20 natural customer openings are selected deterministically from the 687 natural-text openings with a recorded seed and length strata, only dialog_id and integer-derived metadata enter tracked artefacts, the set is frozen, its excluded opening types are stated, and a build-unchanged baseline exists.

tj-vz7o.4 remains open unless the user grants authority for exactly 53 paid claude-haiku-4.5 calls over the stored bot packets; the authority ask and missing client evaluator prompt are recorded, tj-vz7o.5 remains dependent, and no paid call, live traffic, production mutation, real-user message, deploy, or push occurs.
tj-vz7o.8 and tj-vz7o.9 have accurate owner/client decision drafts based on the specified denominators and limitations, but neither draft is sent.

The frozen rubric and _build_applicability_assessment remain unchanged, raw_total is the only client-facing ruler, calculate_weighted_score is the only build-comparison ruler, two transcripts are inspected manually, the corpus remains outside the working tree with mode 0700/0600, required gates pass, commits are local only, and the final working tree is clean.
